selinux.name: SELinux
selinux.description: Kernel-enforced mandatory access control via LSM policy domains. Confines processes to least-privilege security contexts regardless of DAC permissions.

apparmor.name: AppArmor
apparmor.description: Path-based mandatory access control using per-application profiles.

seccomp.name: Seccomp
seccomp.description: Kernel syscall filtering that restricts the system calls a process can invoke, reducing kernel attack surface.

container-runtime.name: Container Runtime Security
container-runtime.description: Container runtime controls including namespace isolation, rootless execution, and sandbox runtimes that strengthen container boundaries.

pod-security.name: Pod Security
pod-security.description: Kubernetes-level controls that enforce security policies on pod specifications, restricting container capabilities and privileges.

systemd-sandboxing.name: systemd Service Sandboxing
systemd-sandboxing.description: Process-level isolation using systemd service directives that restrict filesystem access, device access, and privilege escalation paths.

authentication-methods.name: Authentication Methods
authentication-methods.description: Controls that enforce strong authentication mechanisms including multi-factor, key-based, and protocol-level authentication.

password-policy.name: Password Policy
password-policy.description: Controls that enforce password quality, rotation, and lockout policies to strengthen credential resilience.

session-management.name: Session Management
session-management.description: Controls that manage credential lifecycle including session timeouts, token rotation, and idle session termination.

authorization-controls.name: Authorization Controls
authorization-controls.description: Application-layer controls that enforce role-based access, object-level permissions, and least-privilege authorization policies.

origin-cors.name: Origin and CORS Controls
origin-cors.description: Browser-enforced controls that restrict cross-origin requests, cookie scope, and CSRF attack vectors.

injection-prevention.name: Injection Prevention
injection-prevention.description: Controls that prevent injection attacks across SQL, command, LDAP, template, and other interpreter-based injection vectors.

input-validation.name: Input Validation
input-validation.description: Controls that validate, sanitize, and constrain application inputs to prevent traversal, SSRF, file upload abuse, and other input-driven vulnerabilities.

transport-crypto.name: Transport Cryptography
transport-crypto.description: Controls that protect data in transit through TLS configuration, SSH hardening, and encrypted tunnel enforcement.

mount-options.name: Mount Option Hardening
mount-options.description: Filesystem mount options that restrict execution, setuid, and device access on mounted filesystems.

memory-safety.name: Memory Safety
memory-safety.description: Compiler and runtime protections against memory corruption: ASLR, NX, stack canaries, FORTIFY_SOURCE, heap hardening, RELRO/PIE, CFI, and integer overflow detection.

kernel-attack-surface.name: Kernel Attack Surface Reduction
kernel-attack-surface.description: Kernel self-protection mechanisms that restrict access to kernel memory, prevent unauthorized module loading, and reduce privilege escalation paths.

network-filtering.name: Network Filtering
network-filtering.description: Host and network-level packet filtering, segmentation, service binding restrictions, and egress controls that limit network attack surface.

network-access-control.name: Network Access Control
network-access-control.description: Identity-aware network access, encrypted transport tunnels, and protocol-level protections against network-based attacks.

host-monitoring.name: Host Monitoring
host-monitoring.description: OS and kernel-level runtime detection including audit subsystems, eBPF-based security monitoring, EDR agents, and memory error detection.

application-monitoring.name: Application Monitoring
application-monitoring.description: Application-layer audit logging, privilege change tracking, and SIEM integration for detecting unauthorized access and lateral movement.

integrity-monitoring.name: Integrity Monitoring
integrity-monitoring.description: File integrity monitoring, configuration drift detection, and resource pressure monitoring that detect unauthorized system modifications.

system-recovery.name: System Recovery
system-recovery.description: Controls that enable system restoration after compromise including immutable infrastructure, backup verification, disaster recovery, and service auto-restart.

automated-updates.name: Automated Updates
automated-updates.description: Automated patch management including OS package updates, live kernel patching, and container image rebuilds that reduce the window of vulnerability exposure.

protocol-config.name: Protocol Configuration Hardening
protocol-config.description: Hardening of network protocol configurations including SSH, network services, and kernel network stack parameters.

crypto-policy.name: Cryptographic Policy
crypto-policy.description: System-wide cryptographic policy enforcement and FIPS compliance modes that ensure consistent algorithm and protocol selection.

data-integrity-crypto.name: Data Integrity Cryptography
data-integrity-crypto.description: Cryptographic controls for data integrity and confidentiality including DNSSEC, package signing, and data-at-rest encryption.

verified-integrity.name: Verified Boot and Integrity
verified-integrity.description: Boot-time and runtime integrity verification including dm-verity and IMA/EVM that detect unauthorized modifications to system files.

filesystem-access-control.name: Filesystem Access Control
filesystem-access-control.description: Controls that restrict filesystem access beyond mount options: Landlock LSM sandboxing, dynamic linker hardening, and service path enforcement.

privilege-escalation-control.name: Privilege Escalation Control
privilege-escalation-control.description: Controls that restrict privilege escalation paths including sudo configuration hardening and privilege boundary enforcement.

request-filtering.name: Request Filtering
request-filtering.description: HTTP request-level filtering and normalization including WAFs, rate limiting, and request smuggling prevention.

runtime-hardening.name: Runtime Hardening
runtime-hardening.description: Application runtime security controls including browser security policies, process recycling, and JIT compiler hardening.
